facts.fact: 洛德·图洛克拒绝与罗莉会面，达拉便彻底绕开他，私下联系一位自己认识、当过卫队员工的农场员工，秘密安排会面谈Psilas。
facts.anchor: Lord Toolock refused me a meeting, so Darragh decided to circumvent him entirely and reached out to a staff member he knew who used to be in the guard.

facts.fact: 罗莉在农舍坐下，向老seraph弗拉博自我介绍来自伊甸纳利，向他打听在她之前来过墙这边的人类。
facts.anchor: I sat down in the rickety wooden chair. “It is nice to meet you, Frabo. I’m Rory, and I am from Edenalee. I was told you may have some information about another human who came here before me.”

facts.fact: 弗拉博已故的哥哥十六岁出头时在这座农场与普西拉斯共事，把与一个人类共事的故事讲给他听——这是弗拉博知情的来源。
facts.anchor: My deceased brother worked with Psilas on this farm when he was barely more than sixteen. He told me stories about working with a human.

facts.fact: 据弗拉博转述，普西拉斯始终不明白自己怎么落到提罗奈尔的森林里——当年是谜，如今仍是谜（罗莉第一条线索落空）。
facts.anchor: Psilas maintained he never understood how he ended up in a forest of Tironaill. It was a mystery to everyone back then, as it is now.

facts.fact: 弗拉博说，普西拉斯在醒到墙这边之前正在试配一种新蜂蜜酒配方；他后来在农场试图复原，却始终配不对原料。
facts.anchor: Oh, and my brother did say that Psilas was testing out a new mead recipe before waking up on this side of the wall. He tried to recreate it here but couldn’t get the ingredients right.

facts.fact: 罗莉猛然想起：导师格蕾塔在她和科拉穿越屏障前给她们喝过旅途用的抗焦虑酊剂——她怀疑这就是无害穿墙的原因，想凭草药学知识对照配方破译。
facts.anchor: “Greta, my mentor. She gave us tinctures to drink before we moved through the barrier and wound up here! I don’t know what was in them, but it was a tincture for anxiety during our travel.

facts.fact: 莱里克去找Psilas记配方的书扑空：厨房员工说约十年前一场厨房火灾（一名已故厨子煎猪肉时失手）烧掉了那本孤本。
facts.anchor: The book wasn’t in there, and one of the kitchen staff claims that Psilas’ book, along with some other recipe books, was lost during a kitchen fire about a decade ago.

facts.fact: 莱里克私下透露：格伦清晨打猎时看见两个男人走出迷雾，其中一人被另一个拖着走、被捆绑堵嘴、长着圆耳（人类）；地点在农场西北约两小时骑程、布里亚克利夫村附近。
facts.anchor: One terrified man was being dragged by the other, bound and gagged. He had rounded ears. About a two-hour ride northwest from the farm. Close to Briarscliffe Village.

facts.fact: 达拉为促成这次会面欠下莱里克一个人情；他解释在这边人情等同于货币，并拒绝让罗莉替他背人情。
facts.anchor: “He agreed to arrange the meeting after we didn’t get permission from Lord Toolock, if I would owe him a favor. Favors are as good as currency here.”
